import { test } from 'node:test';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
// passwordless sudo: in the self-hosted container (and on this Mac) there is none; on the VM there is.
const canSudo = process.platform === 'linux' && spawnSync('sudo', ['-n', 'true']).status === 0;
export function unitCases() {
  test('acceptance: the engine unit restarts after a crash', { skip: !canSudo && 'needs passwordless sudo' }, () => {
    const r = spawnSync('sudo', ['-n', 'systemctl', 'restart', 'worklane.service'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(r.stderr);
  });
}
